newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction finds very strong demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction finds very strong demand.

text.p: Very strong demand marked Monday's auction by the Tea Brokers' Association of London and New Season Assams met keen competition with prices ranging between 170 and 230 pence for the best.
East Africans advanced 5-15 pence particularly Dusts which were a very strong feature. Among offshores extremely good demand was seen at substantially dearer rates.
Offered were 3,999 landed packages and 1,000 offshore.
